pr_body:
This completes data streams support to SQL. Querying data streams has
been working transparently already, what has been missing so far is
listing them in metadata discovery.

'SHOW/SYS TABLES' will now correctly list the datastreams as VIEWs.
This will allow BI tools to keep a seamless workflow when querying
data streams.

Fixes #83449.
pr_title: SQL: List data streams as VIEWs
pr_comment: Hi @bpintea, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Hi @bpintea, I've updated the changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: Would it make sense to have a new `IndexType` for data streams?
It normally would, but for drivers this could be problematic with the BI tools.

I had initially the same comment however I agree with @bpintea - I'm not sure what value the distinction would make internally since datastreams are transparent to us. It's clear though that it would complicate slightly some code as the enum would be modified so that SQL views are mapped not just to aliases but also datastreams. Not a big change but an annoying one nevertheless.
